Description.Name: Punisher
Description.Details: Frank Castle was born on New Avalon to parents of Italian ancestry. Enlisted into the Federated Suns Marine Corps, he excelled at every aspect of warfare and was soon trained to become a MechWarrior. After his long tour of duty during the Third Succession War, he came home only to see his family gunned down for no apparent reason. His life having lost all meaning, he went on to hunt down every criminal he could find.
